name: @sample/kb-chat-widget
description: Pre-styled embeddable chat widget for Bedrock Knowledge Bases / Agentic Retrieval — streaming answers, citations, and snippets, built on @sample/kb-chat-react. Ships as an npm package and a standalone script-tag bundle.

scripts.build: tsup src/index.ts --format esm,cjs --dts --external react,react-dom && tsup src/standalone.tsx --format iife --global-name KBChatWidget --minify --platform browser --out-dir dist/standalone --env.NODE_ENV production
